name: Unica La-Speranza
original_name: ユニカ ラスペランツァ
source: The girl resembling Alice whom the protagonist failed to protect. Her father was owner of former Daft Dream Diner before dying and leaving her with full of debts. She has a dream of reviving Daft Dream Diner and becoming the chef following her beloved father to make a place for everyone to relax and enjoy delicious foods.
